handback.summary: The all tests check and the review's test run now collect only the settings' tests folder and file pattern.

criteria.ask: `full-suite.yml` passes the tests folder and pattern to testmon's run, and a missing folder passes saying so; `agent.yml` scopes both review runs; `settings.py` gives `TESTS_FILE_PATTERN`.

handback.evidence: `pytest -q -n auto` on 70 workflow and settings test files: 789 passed.

raises.label: Pattern overrides pytest's own
raises.text: Passing the file pattern replaces a repo's own pytest file pattern, so its `*_test.py` tests skip on pull requests.
